_comment: Friend-code normalization vectors. Alphabet has 30 symbols: A B C D E F G H J K M N P Q R S T V W X Y Z and 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 (no 0 O 1 I L U). Length 8. Normalization: remove every whitespace character and '-', then upper-case, then match ^[ALPHABET]{8}$.

rejected.reason: digit 0 is not in the alphabet
digit 1 is not in the alphabet
letter O is not in the alphabet
letter I is not in the alphabet
letter L is not in the alphabet
letter U is not in the alphabet
underscore is not stripped and is not in the alphabet

unknown_but_valid._comment: well-formed code that no seeded profile owns: lookup returns friend_not_found
